blocks.text: You can use the Intermediate CA Certificates page to manage your custom or default intermediate CA certificate for SSL/TLS Inspection.
The Intermediate CA Certificates provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Protect the highly sensitive root CA certificate.
Scale the organization's certificate issuance processes effectively.
Add an additional layer of security.
Create a multi-tiered certificate chain, making certificate management more structured and easier to manage.

blocks.heading: About the Intermediate CA Certificates Page

blocks.text: On the Intermediate CA Certificates page (Internet Access > Resources > SSL Intermediate Certificate), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Search for the intermediate CA certificate by name, protection type, region, key type, or status.
View a list of all intermediate CA certificates. For each intermediate CA certificate (Software Protection or Cloud HSM Protection), you can view:
Name: The name of the certificate.
Protection Type: The protection type of the certificate.
Region: The region of the certificate.
Validity Start Date: The date from which the certificate is valid.
Expiration Date: The expiration date of the certificate.
Description: Additional notes or information about the certificate.
Key Type: The key type selected while configuring the intermediate CA certificate.
Status: The status of the certificate (enabled or disabled).
Edit or delete a custom intermediate CA certificate.

blocks.text: You cannot delete a draft or the default intermediate CA certificate.

blocks.item: Edit and view the Zscaler Intermediate CA Certificate.
